No DOM, framer-motion, Recharts, Leaflet, lucide, react-i18next runtime, or web UI components are imported; only RN primitives + existing native components (AppText, GlassPanel, SemanticIcon) + theme tokens.
Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles`.
